note: Calamaio's variables: what C-h v describes and M-x customize changes. A changed value is stored in state.settings, kept from one session to the next; the defaults stay here.

inhibit-startup-screen.title: Inhibit Startup Screen
inhibit-startup-screen.description: Whether Calamaio starts in the scratch buffer instead of the start screen.

custom-enabled-themes.title: Custom Enabled Themes
custom-enabled-themes.description: The theme the colours come from: default, inchiostro (dark) or pergamena (strong contrast).

menu-bar-mode.title: Menu Bar Mode
menu-bar-mode.description: Whether the frame shows its menu bar.

tool-bar-mode.title: Tool Bar Mode
tool-bar-mode.description: Whether the frame shows its tool bar, at the end of the menu bar.

cursor-type.title: Cursor Type
cursor-type.description: How point is drawn: a filled box, a thin bar or a line under the character.

global-display-line-numbers-mode.title: Global Display Line Numbers Mode
global-display-line-numbers-mode.description: Whether every buffer shows its line numbers in the margin.

visual-line-mode.title: Visual Line Mode
visual-line-mode.description: Whether long lines wrap at the window's edge instead of running past it.

show-paren-mode.title: Show Paren Mode
show-paren-mode.description: Whether the bracket that matches the one at point is highlighted.

display-fill-column-indicator-mode.title: Display Fill Column Indicator Mode
display-fill-column-indicator-mode.description: Whether a thin line marks the fill column in every buffer.

fill-column.title: Fill Column
fill-column.description: The column the fill column indicator marks, when it is on.

search-highlight.title: Search Highlight
search-highlight.description: Whether incremental search and replace also highlight the other matches.

kill-ring-max.title: Kill Ring Max
kill-ring-max.description: How many kills the kill ring keeps before it forgets the oldest.
